annotations.title: Add a dated mock schedule override

description: Add one dated override to the person's hosting schedule: on that date they host between start and end (HH:MM) instead of their weekly hours. An equal start and end closes the date. Returns the stored rule with its id.

end.description: End of the window, HH:MM; 24:00 means until midnight.

start.description: Start of the window, HH:MM in the person's mock time zone.

name: buddy_mock_schedule_add_override
title: Add a dated mock schedule override
